lifetime_and_caller_matrix.callers: MessageActivity, typed instrumentation, journal/circuit, testing listener/monitor, downstream StartedActivity callers
lifetime_and_caller_matrix.lifetime: Each created activity must be started or abandoned/disposed; Stop/SafeScope.Dispose are once-only. Record previous ambient at successful start; disposal uses captured prior activity when current is owned activity, leaves unrelated current unchanged.
lifetime_and_caller_matrix.risks: All current assignments in creation finally, failed start/catch and disposal finally remain unguarded. CurrentChanged may throw after AsyncLocal write. StartedActivity.AddExceptionEvent prepares GetUtcNow/tags/event before observation guards.
lifetime_and_caller_matrix.design: Shared bounded TrySetCurrent helper with failure reporting where mandatory. Guard entire diagnostic event preparation including injected GetUtcNow; preserve validation arguments outside guard. Never let cleanup replace primary operation failure.

lifetime_and_caller_matrix.callers: SendTransport, ReceivePipeDispatcher, Consumer/Instance/Handler filters, OutboxSendEndpoint/OutboxMessagePipe/EFTransactionalOutboxSource, Courier/Saga wrappers, EventHubProducer, ConfigureServiceBusTopologyFilter, DeserializeFilter
lifetime_and_caller_matrix.lifetime: Process static Lazy<ActivitySource> with per-operation optional StartedActivity. Caller awaits actual business operation then stops activity in finally. Trace parent remote/link/new behavior and baggage/header propagation remain defined.
lifetime_and_caller_matrix.risks: Lazy factory caches exception but is called inside TryCreate; final ambient restore may still escape. Source name/version must remain unchanged. Preparing context metadata/configure/propagation is currently beyond core observation catch.
lifetime_and_caller_matrix.design: Nullable/inert cached source factory without static type poisoning; do not add exporters/config endpoints. Preserve successful source sampling, recorded flags, traceparent/baggage/newRoot semantics; independently qualify any additional context/propagation changes.

lifetime_and_caller_matrix.design: Guard source creation only and permit null source with continuing host Meter; existing no-observability-fallback and bounded metric dimensions stay. Own/dispose any successfully returned source; no cached half-initialized factory result.

adversarial_design_risks: Guarded Activity.Current write must never recursively retry under arbitrary CurrentChanged reentrancy. Ordinary throw occurs after AsyncLocal write; handler can reenter and change ambient again. No universal restoration guarantee or global listener/event suppression.

ActivitySource constructor adds itself to runtime active source list before invoking ShouldListenTo. If constructor throws, public call returns no disposable handle, so a wrapper cannot prove removal of that hidden half-constructed source. Bound creation attempts; do not promise zero runtime-global allocation/leak or infinite healthy retry.

Do not cache constructor exceptions in static readonly initialization. Optional Lazy factory may return null without type poisoning; required monitor needs original failure reporting and an explicit bounded recovery/lifetime policy.
Typed ActivitySource null must not disable independent host-owned metrics. No IMeterFactory instance ownership transfer or disposal; returned source is instance-owned.
A safe helper receiving a prepared duration cannot catch caller argument evaluation. Guard TimeProvider.GetTimestamp/GetElapsedTime/GetUtcNow only at identified optional preparation call sites.

Do not invent valid timestamps/durations after failed reads. Explicit unavailable/nullable start and skip duration or established documented zero convention; preserve outcome counters when duration cannot be observed.

Monitor idle deadlines and timer callbacks are correctness, not optional diagnostic timing. Do not silently complete a failed monitor. Preserve actual task cancellation and exception identity; callback failure must be delivered through owned monitor completion if modified.

Dispose cleanup must attempt every owned resource even when another fails, and secondary ambient/logging failures may not replace required primary startup/operation failure. Any recovery scope narrower than framework-global behavior must be stated.

Trace header propagation/context metadata and NotifyFaultedAsync may execute declared provider/caller/fault behavior. Do not swallow arbitrary body/context/business methods through a blanket telemetry catch.
Circuit/Journal constructor partial cleanup must dispose successfully returned process-owned objects while respecting host Meter ownership; preserve no DI-to-process fallback.
